title: Pipeline record
description: One pipeline: a project with a chartbook.toml that declares assets.

location.description: Where the pipeline's source comes from. `value` is a local directory and is absent from a published index.

modified_at.description: When the file, or the newest file the glob names, was last written, in UTC. Absent when not built.

dependencies.description: The pipelines this one declares in [dependencies]. Absent when the manifest has no such table.

id.description: The pipeline's ID in this index when it is one of its pipelines; otherwise its key in [dependencies].

via.description: Whether it comes from a local directory, a fetched revision, or the store by its ID alone.

location.description: Where the dependency's source comes from. For a directory, `path` is as declared and `value` is absolute and absent from a published index.

rev.description: The revision as [dependencies] declares it: a branch, a tag or a commit. Absent for the repository's default branch.

commit.description: The commit the dependency is pinned at. For a repository, what `rev` meant when it was pinned. For a directory, the commit its snapshot was built from. Present once chartbook.lock has pinned it; absent for a directory pinned from its folder as it stood.

pipeline.description: For a dependency named by its ID alone: the pipeline's own ID, whose snapshots are looked for in the store (`kind: store`), or whose repository it was got from when the store had none (`kind: git`, with no `url`: each machine works the address out from its `[resolve] default_host`).

at.description: For `kind: store`: the start of the commit its snapshots are narrowed to, as [dependencies] declares it (`commit`).

repository.description: For `kind: store`, in chartbook.lock: the web address of the repository its snapshots are taken from, as the snapshot it was pinned from, or another of that repository's, records it.

first_commit.description: For `kind: store`, in chartbook.lock: the first commit of the repository it was pinned from. Later pins and updates keep to that repository, by this or by its address.

snapshot.description: For a directory: when the snapshot it is pinned from was made, in UTC. With `location.commit`, it names the snapshot.

assets.description: IDs of the pipeline's assets. Series are listed under their dataframe, not here.

docs.description: The write-up: the file it is in, or the text itself when it was written inline.

content_hash.description: The hash of the write-up's text, so a build says which text it showed. Write-ups are not pinned; the commit holds them.

code_changed_at.description: When the pipeline's code last changed, in UTC, as a docs build worked it out: the last commit that touched the source where it is committed and unmodified, else the newest modification time. Present only in an index a docs build writes; an index built from a manifest as loaded leaves it out.

site_url.description: Where the pipeline's own site is published, as the manifest declares it. Absent from a published index when it is a local file:// path.

site_dir.description: The folder of pages the pipeline supplies for its own site: `[project] site_dir`, or `docs_src/site/` when that exists. Absent when it supplies none.

resolved_path.description: Absolute path on the machine that built the index. Absent from a published index.

site_pages.description: Every Markdown file under `site_dir`, by path relative to it, sorted. The build copies them beside the generated pages; `index_toc.md` at the root, if present, is merged into the front page instead.

snapshots.description: The snapshots of this pipeline in the store of the machine that built the index, newest first: each a version its owner declared ready. A catalog renders each as its own site, at `versions/<pipeline>/<name>/`. Absent when the store holds none.

name.description: The version's folder name: the commit's first seven digits and when the snapshot was made.

built_by_run.description: True when `chartbook run --snapshot` built the bytes in the same command.

rendered.description: Whether the catalog that wrote this index built the snapshot's site; false when it shows the page that says why.

tags.description: The git tags on the snapshot's commit when it was made: its names.

from_snapshot.description: Present when the pipeline's folder is a version laid out from the store (`chartbook.snapshot.materialize`): which snapshot it is.
